root_cause.text: In `drivers/net/ovpn/io.c:ovpn_net_xmit`, the TX path builds a segmented `skb_list` with `skb_share_check()` but then still uses the original `skb` for peer lookup, `skb_dst_drop()`, and TX stats, even though `skb_share_check()` may free that shared original `skb`, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit explicitly states that “`skb_share_check` will free the original skb if it is shared” and that the old code “continues to use the stale skb pointer” for “peer lookup, `skb_dst_drop`, `ovpn_peer_stats_increment_tx`”; the patch fixes this by moving peer lookup and `skb_dst_drop` before segmentation and changing stats to use `skb_list.next->len` instead of `skb->len`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Select the transmit peer from the packet destination, log and drop packets with no matching peer, and release dst metadata after peer lookup.
intent_record.what: The code changes the early protocol-validation failure path from `goto drop` to `goto drop_no_peer`, then adds logic to look up a peer with `ovpn_peer_get_by_dst(ovpn, skb)`. If no peer is found, it emits a ratelimited debug message with the destination IPv4 or IPv6 address depending on `skb->protocol`, and jumps to `drop_no_peer`. If a peer is found, it calls `skb_dst_drop(skb)` before continuing to GSO handling.
intent_record.how: At runtime, transmitted packets are now associated with a peer selected from the packet destination address before further processing. Packets that have a valid IP protocol but no matching peer are explicitly dropped through the no-peer path and produce destination-specific debug logs, improving diagnosability. Dropping the skb dst after peer selection also releases routing metadata once it is no longer needed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix segmented transmit handling by safely exiting when no skb segments remain, updating stats for the transmitted segment, and releasing the peer reference on all error paths.
intent_record.what: The change removes the per-packet peer lookup, missing-peer debug logging, destination drop, and tx stats update based on the original skb after segmentation, and instead adds an early check for an empty skb_list before finalizing the list; if the list is empty it releases the peer and returns NETDEV_TX_OK. It then restores skb_list.prev->next = NULL after that check, updates tx stats using skb_list.next->len, and adds ovpn_peer_put(peer) to the drop path plus a separate drop_no_peer label.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents dereferencing or using an empty segmented skb list when all segments have already failed inside the loop, avoiding falling into the generic drop path that would double-account failures. It also ensures the peer reference is released on both the empty-list and drop paths, and records transmit stats based on the skb that is actually sent.

Fix segmented transmit handling by safely exiting when no skb segments remain, updating stats for the transmitted segment, and releasing the peer reference on all error paths.

The changes are in the segmented transmit path and address incorrect handling of skb segments and related resources on error/success paths, which is directly tied to the root cause of using the wrong skb after segmentation/share-check in ovpn_net_xmit.
